profile:
(version 1)
(deny default)
(import "system.sb")
(allow process-fork)
(allow signal (target same-sandbox))
(allow file-read-metadata)
(allow sysctl-read)
(allow file-read* (literal "/dev/null") (literal "/dev/zero") (literal "/dev/random") (literal "/dev/urandom"))
(allow file-write-data (literal "/dev/null"))
(allow file-read* process-exec (subpath (param "SYS_0")) (subpath (param "SYS_1")) (subpath (param "SYS_2")) (subpath (param "SYS_3")) (subpath (param "SYS_4")))
(allow file-read* process-exec (literal (param "EXE_0")) (literal (param "EXE_1")))
(allow file-read* (literal (param "EXEDIR_0")))
(allow file-read* process-exec (subpath (param "RO_0")))
(allow file-read* file-write* (subpath (param "RW_0")) (subpath (param "RW_1")))
(deny file-write-flags (subpath (param "RWF_0")))
(deny file-write-acl (subpath (param "RWA_0")) (subpath (param "RWA_1")))
(deny file-write-unlink (literal (param "RWR_0")) (literal (param "RWR_1")))
(deny file-link)
(allow iokit-open-user-client (iokit-user-client-class "H11ANEInDirectPathClient" "H11ANEInUserClient" "H1xANELoadBalancerDirectPathClient" "H1xANEInDirectPathClient"))
(allow mach-lookup (global-name "com.apple.appleneuralengine"))
(allow iokit-open-user-client (iokit-user-client-class "IOSurfaceRootUserClient" "AGXDeviceUserClient"))
(allow mach-lookup (global-name "com.apple.cvmsServ"))
(allow file-issue-extension (require-all (extension-class "com.apple.app-sandbox.read") (subpath (param "SCRATCH_EXT"))))
(allow mach-lookup (global-name (param "CANARY")))
(deny network*)
